verses.original: Ὦ ἀνόητοι Γαλάται τίς ἐβάσκανεν ὑμᾶς κατ’ οἷς ὀφθαλμοὺς Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς προεγράφη ἐσταυρωμένος
verses.transliteration: Ō anoētoi Galatai tis ebaskanen hymas kat’ hois ophthalmous Iēsous Christos proegraphē estaurōmenos
verses.literal: O foolish Galatians Who has bewitched you Before [your very] eyes Jesus Christ was clearly portrayed [as] crucified

verses.original: θέλω μαθεῖν μόνον τοῦτο ἀφ’ ὑμῶν ἐλάβετε τὸ Πνεῦμα ἐξ ἔργων νόμου ἢ ἐξ ἀκοῆς πίστεως
verses.transliteration: thelō mathein monon touto aph’ hymōn elabete to Pneuma ex ergōn nomou ē ex akoēs pisteōs
verses.literal: I would like to learn just [one thing] from you Did you receive the Spirit by works of the law or by hearing with faith

verses.original: ἐστε Οὕτως ἀνόητοί ἐναρξάμενοι Πνεύματι νῦν ἐπιτελεῖσθε σαρκὶ
verses.transliteration: este Houtōs anoētoi enarxamenoi Pneumati nyn epiteleisthe sarki
verses.literal: Are you so foolish After starting in [the] Spirit vvv are you now finishing in [the] flesh

verses.original: ἐπάθετε τοσαῦτα εἰκῇ εἴ γε καὶ εἰκῇ
verses.transliteration: epathete tosauta eikē ei ge kai eikē
verses.literal: Have you suffered so much for nothing if it really was . . . for nothing

verses.original: οὖν ὁ ἐπιχορηγῶν τὸ Πνεῦμα ὑμῖν καὶ ἐνεργῶν δυνάμεις ἐν ὑμῖν ἐξ ἔργων νόμου ἢ ἐξ ἀκοῆς πίστεως
verses.transliteration: oun ho epichorēgōn to Pneuma hymin kai energōn dynameis en hymin ex ergōn nomou ē ex akoēs pisteōs
verses.literal: - {Does} [God] lavish [His] Spirit on you and work miracles among you because [you] practice the law or because [you] hear [and] believe

verses.original: Καθὼς Ἀβραὰμ ἐπίστευσεν τῷ Θεῷ καὶ ἐλογίσθη αὐτῷ εἰς δικαιοσύνην
verses.transliteration: Kathōs Abraam episteusen tō Theō kai elogisthē autō eis dikaiosynēn
verses.literal: So also Abraham believed - God and it was credited to him as righteousness

verses.original: Γινώσκετε ἄρα ὅτι οἱ ἐκ πίστεως οὗτοι εἰσιν υἱοί Ἀβραάμ
verses.transliteration: Ginōskete ara hoti hoi ek pisteōs houtoi eisin huioi Abraam
verses.literal: Understand then that those who have faith - are sons of Abraham

verses.original: δὲ ἡ γραφὴ προϊδοῦσα ὅτι ὁ Θεὸς δικαιοῖ τὰ ἔθνη ἐκ πίστεως προευηγγελίσατο τῷ Ἀβραὰμ ὅτι πάντα τὰ ἔθνη Ἐνευλογηθήσονται ἐν σοὶ
verses.transliteration: de hē graphē proidousa hoti ho Theos dikaioi ta ethnē ek pisteōs proeuēngelisato tō Abraam hoti panta ta ethnē Eneulogēthēsontai en soi
verses.literal: - The Scripture foresaw that - God would justify the Gentiles by faith [and] foretold the gospel - to Abraham - All - nations will be blessed through you

verses.original: ὥστε οἱ ἐκ πίστεως εὐλογοῦνται σὺν Ἀβραάμ τῷ πιστῷ
verses.transliteration: hōste hoi ek pisteōs eulogountai syn Abraam tō pistō
verses.literal: So those who have faith are blessed along with Abraham the [man] of faith

verses.original: γὰρ Ὅσοι εἰσὶν ἐξ ἔργων νόμου εἰσίν ὑπὸ κατάραν γὰρ γέγραπται ὅτι Ἐπικατάρατος πᾶς ὃς οὐκ ἐμμένει τοῦ ποιῆσαι αὐτά πᾶσιν τοῖς γεγραμμένοις ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ τοῦ νόμου
verses.transliteration: gar Hosoi eisin ex ergōn nomou eisin hypo kataran gar gegraptai hoti Epikataratos pas hos ouk emmenei tou poiēsai auta pasin tois gegrammenois en tō bibliō tou nomou
verses.literal: - All who rely on . . . works of the law are under a curse For it is written - Cursed is everyone who vvv does not continue - to do vvv everything - written in the Book of the Law

verses.original: δὲ δῆλον ὅτι οὐδεὶς δικαιοῦται παρὰ τῷ Θεῷ ἐν νόμῳ ὅτι Ὁ δίκαιος ζήσεται ἐκ πίστεως
verses.transliteration: de dēlon hoti oudeis dikaioutai para tō Theō en nomō hoti Ho dikaios zēsetai ek pisteōs
verses.literal: Now it is clear that no one is justified before - God by [the] law because The righteous will live by faith

verses.original: ὁ νόμος δὲ ἔστιν οὐκ ἐκ πίστεως ἀλλ’ Ὁ ποιήσας αὐτὰ ζήσεται ἐν αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: ho nomos de estin ouk ek pisteōs all’ Ho poiēsas auta zēsetai en autois
verses.literal: The law however is not based on faith on the contrary The [man who] does these things will live by them

verses.original: Χριστὸς ἐξηγόρασεν ἡμᾶς ἐκ τῆς κατάρας τοῦ νόμου γενόμενος κατάρα ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν ὅτι γέγραπται Ἐπικατάρατος πᾶς ὁ κρεμάμενος ἐπὶ ξύλου
verses.transliteration: Christos exēgorasen hēmas ek tēs kataras tou nomou genomenos katara hyper hēmōn hoti gegraptai Epikataratos pas ho kremamenos epi xylou
verses.literal: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for us For it is written Cursed is everyone who is hung on a tree

verses.original: ἵνα ἡ εὐλογία τοῦ Ἀβραὰμ γένηται εἰς τὰ ἔθνη ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ ἵνα διὰ τῆς πίστεως λάβωμεν τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν τοῦ Πνεύματος
verses.transliteration: hina hē eulogia tou Abraam genētai eis ta ethnē en Christō Iēsou hina dia tēs pisteōs labōmen tēn epangelian tou Pneumatos
verses.literal: [He redeemed us] in order that the blessing promised - to Abraham would come to the Gentiles in Christ Jesus so that by - faith we might receive the promise of the Spirit

verses.original: Ἀδελφοί λέγω κατὰ ἄνθρωπον ὅμως διαθήκην ἀνθρώπου κεκυρωμένην οὐδεὶς ἀθετεῖ ἢ ἐπιδιατάσσεται
verses.transliteration: Adelphoi legō kata anthrōpon homōs diathēkēn anthrōpou kekyrōmenēn oudeis athetei ē epidiatassetai
verses.literal: Brothers let me put this in human terms . . . Even a human covenant . . . once it is ratified cannot be canceled or amended

verses.original: δὲ αἱ ἐπαγγελίαι ἐρρέθησαν τῷ Ἀβραὰμ καὶ τῷ αὐτοῦ σπέρματι οὐ λέγει Καὶ τοῖς σπέρμασιν ὡς ἐπὶ πολλῶν ἀλλ’ Καὶ τῷ σου σπέρματί ὡς ἐφ’ ἑνός ὅς ἐστιν Χριστός
verses.transliteration: de hai epangeliai errethēsan tō Abraam kai tō autou spermati ou legei Kai tois spermasin hōs epi pollōn all’ Kai tō sou spermati hōs eph’ henos hos estin Christos
verses.literal: - The promises were spoken - to Abraham and to his seed vvv [The Scripture ] does not say and - to seeds vvv meaning many but and to your seed vvv meaning One who is Christ

verses.original: δὲ λέγω Τοῦτο ὁ νόμος γεγονὼς τετρακόσια καὶ τριάκοντα ἔτη μετὰ οὐκ ἀκυροῖ διαθήκην προκεκυρωμένην ὑπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰς τὸ καταργῆσαι τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν
verses.transliteration: de legō Touto ho nomos gegonōs tetrakosia kai triakonta etē meta ouk akyroi diathēkēn prokekyrōmenēn hypo tou Theou eis to katargēsai tēn epangelian
verses.literal: - What I mean [is] this - [The] law that came 430 {} . . . . . . years later vvv does not revoke [the] covenant previously established by - God so as - to nullify the promise

verses.original: γὰρ εἰ ἡ κληρονομία ἐκ νόμου οὐκέτι ἐξ ἐπαγγελίας δὲ ὁ Θεός κεχάρισται τῷ Ἀβραὰμ δι’ ἐπαγγελίας
verses.transliteration: gar ei hē klēronomia ek nomou ouketi ex epangelias de ho Theos kecharistai tō Abraam di’ epangelias
verses.literal: For if the inheritance depends on [the] law [then it] no longer depends on a promise but - God freely granted [it] - to Abraham through a promise

verses.original: Τί οὖν ὁ νόμος προσετέθη χάριν τῶν παραβάσεων ἄχρις ἔλθῃ τὸ σπέρμα οὗ ᾧ ἐπήγγελται διαταγεὶς δι’ ἀγγέλων ἐν χειρὶ μεσίτου
verses.transliteration: Ti oun ho nomos prosetethē charin tōn parabaseōn achris elthē to sperma hou hō epēngeltai diatageis di’ angelōn en cheiri mesitou
verses.literal: Why then [ was ] the law [ given ] It was added because of - transgressions until [the] arrival of the seed vvv to whom [the] promise referred It was administered through angels by vvv a mediator

verses.original: ὁ μεσίτης ἔστιν οὐκ δὲ ἑνὸς δὲ ὁ Θεὸς ἐστιν εἷς
verses.transliteration: ho mesitēs estin ouk de henos de ho Theos estin heis
verses.literal: - A mediator is unnecessary however [ for only ] one [ party ] but - God is one

verses.original: Ὁ νόμος οὖν κατὰ τῶν ἐπαγγελιῶν τοῦ Θεοῦ μὴ γένοιτο γὰρ εἰ νόμος ἐδόθη ὁ δυνάμενος ζωοποιῆσαι ἂν ἡ δικαιοσύνη ὄντως ἦν ἐκ νόμου
verses.transliteration: Ho nomos oun kata tōn epangeliōn tou Theou mē genoito gar ei nomos edothē ho dynamenos zōopoiēsai an hē dikaiosynē ontōs ēn ek nomou
verses.literal: [Is] the law then opposed to the promises - of God vvv Certainly not For if a law had been given that could impart life then - righteousness {would} certainly have come from [the] law

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ἡ γραφὴ πάντα τὰ συνέκλεισεν ὑπὸ ἁμαρτίαν ἵνα ἐκ πίστεως Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἡ ἐπαγγελία δοθῇ τοῖς πιστεύουσιν
verses.transliteration: alla hē graphē panta ta synekleisen hypo hamartian hina ek pisteōs Iēsou Christou hē epangelia dothē tois pisteuousin
verses.literal: But the Scripture [ pronounces ] all things confined by sin so that by faith in Jesus Christ the promise might be given to those who believe

verses.original: δὲ Πρὸ τοῦ τὴν πίστιν ἐλθεῖν ἐφρουρούμεθα ὑπὸ νόμον συνκλειόμενοι εἰς τὴν πίστιν μέλλουσαν ἀποκαλυφθῆναι
verses.transliteration: de Pro tou tēn pistin elthein ephrouroumetha hypo nomon synkleiomenoi eis tēn pistin mellousan apokalyphthēnai
verses.literal: - Before - [this] faith came we were held in custody under the law locked up until - faith should be revealed

verses.original: ὥστε ὁ νόμος γέγονεν ἡμῶν παιδαγωγὸς εἰς Χριστόν ἵνα δικαιωθῶμεν ἐκ πίστεως
verses.transliteration: hōste ho nomos gegonen hēmōn paidagōgos eis Christon hina dikaiōthōmen ek pisteōs
verses.literal: So the law became our guardian to lead us to Christ that we might be justified by faith

verses.original: δὲ τῆς πίστεως ἐλθούσης ἐσμεν οὐκέτι ὑπὸ παιδαγωγόν
verses.transliteration: de tēs pisteōs elthousēs esmen ouketi hypo paidagōgon
verses.literal: Now [that] faith has come we are no longer under a guardian

verses.original: γὰρ ἐστε Πάντες υἱοὶ Θεοῦ διὰ τῆς πίστεως ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: gar este Pantes huioi Theou dia tēs pisteōs en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: - You are all sons of God through - faith in Christ Jesus

verses.original: γὰρ ὅσοι ἐβαπτίσθητε εἰς Χριστὸν ἐνεδύσασθε Χριστὸν
verses.transliteration: gar hosoi ebaptisthēte eis Christon enedysasthe Christon
verses.literal: For all of you [who] were baptized into Christ have clothed yourselves with Christ

verses.original: ἔνι οὐκ Ἰουδαῖος οὐδὲ Ἕλλην ἔνι οὐκ δοῦλος οὐδὲ ἐλεύθερος ἔνι οὐκ ἄρσεν καὶ θῆλυ γὰρ ὑμεῖς ἐστε πάντες εἷς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: eni ouk Ioudaios oude Hellēn eni ouk doulos oude eleutheros eni ouk arsen kai thēly gar hymeis este pantes heis en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: There is neither Jew nor Greek - - slave nor free - - male [nor] female for you are all one in Christ Jesus

verses.original: δὲ εἰ ὑμεῖς Χριστοῦ ἄρα ἐστέ τοῦ Ἀβραὰμ σπέρμα κληρονόμοι κατ’ ἐπαγγελίαν
verses.transliteration: de ei hymeis Christou ara este tou Abraam sperma klēronomoi kat’ epangelian
verses.literal: And if you belong to Christ then you are - Abraham’s seed [and] heirs according to [the] promise
